single_dose: adults 800mg to 1600 mg per dose three times daily || adults an average dose is about 2.4g with each meal || adults the maximum dose one can take is 13g per day
mechanism_of_action: controls the levels of phosphorous minerals in patients with chronic kidney illnesses
side_effects: itching, joint pain, constipation, diarrhea, nausea, muscle weakness, appetite loss, bloating and stomach pain || bloody and tarry stool, choking, severe constipation and trouble swallowing
unsuitable_population: allergies to any of the ingredients in Reganel medication || have bowel obstruction, severe constipation or intestinal blockage || recently undergone abdominal or stomach surgery or have problems in both areas || if you experience slow digestion
storage_conditions: store at room temperature || protect from light
